estimate: About 200 hours, difficulty 4/10, one playthrough, no online trophies. Source: PowerPyx.
cheats: Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off on your trophy save (PowerPyx). There are no difficulty settings and no mission medals, so nothing about difficulty can lock you out.

missable.body: PowerPyx flags exactly one: Positive Mental Attitude, because the first meditation — Lucia on the balcony at Jason’s house in Chapter 1 — disappears after that chapter, and it is unconfirmed whether it counts toward the trophy. Do it in Chapter 1 and you are safe. Every other trophy is confirmed obtainable after the story in free-roam: there is no mission replay, but there are 15 manual save slots, so keep a save at the start and end of each chapter as insurance. Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off on your trophy save.
missable.headline: Only 1 trophy is flagged as potentially missable.

stages.intro: Play the story and take the one warning in this whole guide seriously: do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before the chapter ends (see Positive Mental Attitude). Scan vehicles and study animals as you go — the counts already feed the 100% checklist.
notes: Chapter 1: Gone Fishing, then Chapter 1 complete.
Chapter 2: Breakfast Run, then Chapter 2 complete.
Meditation warning: after “Down to Earth”, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose “Accept”.
From Chapter 2’s “Coffee Break” you can play Jason and Lucia together — most duo trophies open from here.
stages.title: Story — Chapters 1 & 2

stages.intro: Keep playing the story. Side questlines start opening in these chapters — take them when they appear, but nothing trophy-related is missable except the Chapter 1 meditation you already did.
notes: Chapter 3: The Cartel Heist, then Chapter 3 complete. Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs unlocks the Snap Gun and jewelry robberies.
Chapter 4: Child’s Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, then Chapter 4 complete.
Chapter 4 optional mission “That’s Where The Money Is…” unlocks bank-vault robberies — and pops Hot Together and A Classic Blitz Play on the way.
stages.title: Story — Chapters 3 & 4

stages.intro: Finish the story. Keep a manual save from before the finale: the game has no mission replay and 15 manual save slots, so save at the start and end of each chapter.
notes: Chapter 5: Operation Savage Glory.
Final mission: the gold trophy for finishing the story.
After the credits you return to free-roam and the 100% checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
stages.title: Story — final chapter & final mission

stages.intro: Finish every character questline and 8 stranger strands. All of them stay available after the story, so this stage can also run during the story whenever a questline appears.
notes: Andy (Lucia-only, Chapter 3), Kenton (7 shipwrecks), Billy (Thrillbilly Mudclub), Randy (16 sports cars), Tyrone (Jason-only, synthetic labs), Bret (Jason-only, hunting).
Strangers & Freaks: only Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not.
stages.title: Side & stranger missions

stages.intro: Sweep Leonida for the counted collectibles. None of these is missable; the map marks what you have found under Map > Exploration.
notes: WAiNK It at 100 locations (landmarks, curiosities, sculptures).
Discover 100 vehicles — 200 of 277 base models for 100%.
Complete 3 collectible card sets.
Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — fly a plane over the fog.
Meditate at all 18 spots (10 locations); each spot with both characters counts +2.
stages.title: Collectibles

stages.intro: The long tail: stunts, ranges, races and challenges. Do the easiest ones first — every one of these lets you skip the hardest entries.
notes: 250 stunts of 397 (300 for 100%).
Gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges (12 ranges).
A Top Fun drone race win at all 14 locations; 20 different race wins.
50 of 80 challenges (70 for 100%).
Try all 9 activity types; beat Cal fishing; finish one arcade game.
5 enemies in one Combat Focus; max strength with both characters.
stages.title: Activities & grind

stages.intro: The crime half of the list. Most of it feeds the 100% checklist, which needs all 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations.
notes: 5 of 8 bank vaults (8 for 100%), an armored truck, a jewelry store undetected, one illegal operation per gang (9 gangs).
Hot Together and Retail Therapy need your partner beside you.
Steal the VCIA plane and a Rhino tank — both are one-off set pieces.
Launder $250,000 of marked bills, spend $100,000 in shops, buy all 8 garages, register 10 vehicles with Scooter Bros.
stages.title: Robberies, gangs & money

stages.intro: Close out the 100% checklist, mop up the five still-unconfirmed trophies if guides have appeared for them, then the platinum pops.
notes: A Long Road: the checklist is about 60% true completion — most of it is already done by this point.
Actions Speak Louder: 500 criminal-profile actions, accrued passively.
Still unconfirmed at launch: In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin — check the cited guides for updates.
Vice Got a Price!: earn every other trophy and the platinum is yours.
stages.title: 100% cleanup & the platinum
